notes.title: Update Notes 2.5.0 - Custom Avatars
notes.content:
Hey everyone Update 2.5.0 is Live now!

What's new:

🏅 Achievements - a bunch of challenges to be unlocked, check out the new profile menu.

🔥 Avatar Customizations - customize your avatar with unlockable items.

🆚 Versus season 5
    3 new Versus sets:
        🌟  Adhara by Sinteck
        🌕  Moonshot by Unmarked
        🛰️  Sputnik II by Boztizch

    3 new Versus rules:
        📏  Wave clock - instead of a 5 minutes round clock, we now have a 1 minute wave clock. When it ends, the next wave loads.
        📏  Shot clock - From the moment the ball changes to your color, you have 8 seconds to take your shot before your turn ends.
        📏  Score cap - The maximum score per shot is 500 points (diminishing returns above 250).

🚧  Change log from the last Beta version:
    📏  Rule change: 100 points bonus for the last target reverted back to 50 points.
     🛠️ Tweak: Wave end sound changed.
    🐞  Bug fix: Wave skipped bug
    🐞  Bug fix: Shielded portals in multiplayer bug fix.
    🐞  Bug fix: Wrecking ball ending sound plays after the powerup ended.
    🐞  Bug fix: Announcer not announcing the score between rounds in Versus.

🗒️ Note: The January MC will start early next week.

GL;HF

notes.title: New Season, Monthly Challenge, and More!
notes.content:
Gather ‘round, boys & girls:

Season 4 of Racket: Nx is here, which means that the battle for the leaderboard is now open!

And if this wasn't enough, we have also launched an update that will make the new season more interesting and competitive, including:

[list]
[*] Matchmaking - you are matched against players of your skill level (when possible)
[*] Glicko rating system - your score reflects your performance more accurately
[*] Three new multiplayer Versus Sets
[*] High five - enabled
[*] Bug fixes and improvements
[/list]

But that's not all, our March monthly challenge also begins today! So grab your headset and prepare for some fresh content.

These exciting features and updates make March the month to be reckoned with; so warm-up, aim your sights high on the leaderboard, and take part in this season's most electric sports VR event!

    * Snap turn overhaul - smoother, more responsive and should work better on all platforms

    * High five - enabled
    
- Bug fixes:
    * Fixed: Targets don't load after first round for one of the players
    * Fixed: Ball slides very fast on the wall for no good reason
    * Patch: Wrecking Ball abuse in Versus - timer doesn't run during opponent's turn
    * Patch: Grabity sling limited to 5 seconds of trigger time per turn to avoid exploits

notes.title: Patched!
notes.content:
We have a new patch out addressing most of the bugs and issues we've been aware of.

Here's what's in it:

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[list]
[*]In Arcade mode there is now more Wave variety when reaching Wave 50 and beyond. The game will draw from a larger Wave pool when reaching these high difficulties.
[*]In Multiplayer, the Sling (Tractor Beam) is now limited to 2 seconds (instead of 5) before the ball switches to the opponent. This is to avoid abuse and keep the game pace high. It also the mitigates advantage players had of having the first shot in a new Wave containing a Powerup, where by abusing the Sling players could line up their shot perfectly and take the Powerup.
[/list]

[h1]Bugs[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed ball losing Powershot on Oculus when touching the trigger immediately after the hit.
[*]Fixed Oculus playspace center when chaperon is not setup.
[*]Fixed Wrecking ball stuck in floor bug.
[*]Fixed Nuke Powerup heat marker staying when game is over.
[*]Fixed streaming camera that could be placed inside the wall.
[*]Fixed Splash damage pellet scale bug.
[*]Fixed problem playing read-only mp3 files.
[*]Fixed a few UI bugs where certain menus would wrongly persist.
[*]Fixed a bunch of other small bugs.
[/list]

[h1]Other stuff[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added option to force SteamVR or Oculus through the config (VR SDK: force_openvr & force_oculusvr).
[*]Added option to switch network port through config.
[/list]

We still have one open bug concerning the Star rating given in Solo Insane stage Sets. For some players, 3 Stars are given even when not finishing the set in the required time.
If you have any information about this bug, please contact us here or on Discord.

That's it for now!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2

[list]
[*]Fixed bug where My Music would sometimes skip track or behave erratically.
[*]Fixed a mistake where Arcade was disabled until completing a solo set.
[*]Fixed bug where declining a found multiplayer match wouldn't actually decline it.
[*]Optimized sun surface performance in Solo game over screen.
[*]Fixed a few visual UI bugs in main menu.
[*]Fixed main menu profile "RP earned this session" calculation.
[*]Fixed bug where if an Oculus Home player had no player Avatar, game wouldn't sync with servers.
[*]Made announcer say the name of taken Powerups in Zen mode.
[*]Fixed bug where Splash Damage pellets wouldn't spiral.
[*]Tweaked "Clutch Saves" statistic to include slightly less critical situations.
[*]Fixed bug where sliders would remain visible after multiplayer round was over.
[*]Fixed bug where blue opponent handle was red.
[/list]

We fixed about a dozen additional tiny things that aren't worth noting.

Please let us know if you run into any bugs or issues!

notes.title: Powerup Guide!
notes.content:
[b]Powerups![/b]
They're everywhere.
But who are these Powerups and what can they do for [i]you[/i]?

This short guide will teach you all there is to know about the different types of Powerups; How do they work? What are they called? What are they good for?

But first, here are a few general rules:
[list]
[*]Powerups appear at the start of a wave, and disappear when it's over if they weren't taken.
[*]In Multiplayer, taking a Powerup will return the ball to the player who took it rather than changing side - so double shot!
[*]In Arcade and Multiplayer, Powerups appear randomly. In Solo, they are all predetermined.
[/list]
Now let's go over them.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011592/8b774c342d92d0150747b9f71fdf9a096db8165b.png[/img]
[list][*][h1]Splash Damage[/h1]
For the next 5 shots, your racket will release little pellets that will damage the area around where the ball hits. This is really good for big or elusive targets.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011592/fd9ed1b880ab0f78913e130e58c958531490741d.png[/img]
[list][*][h1]God Mode[/h1]
Fully charges your energy and keeps it there for 30 seconds. During this time, all downers turn blue and behave like boosters!
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011592/e4a4e30b1df2b1043b8de1fc67ed54b61abf7962.png[/img]
[list][*][h1]Blaster Maze[/h1]
Randomly generates a maze of golden Blaster walls for the duration of the wave. Sliding into a Blaster will give the ball a kick, and do damage to the tile on the other side of the Blaster. CHAOS!
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011592/8b3f1060d58866850b303a95ecbed9dd02f76346.png[/img]
[list][*][h1]Hyperspace[/h1]
Time speeds up by 30% for 30 seconds. Your energy won't drain faster, though.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011592/db3ba424527764cef4569d333fa11f9666199197.png[/img]
[list][*][h1]NUKE[/h1]
Does a s%#t ton of damage to everything in the red zone behind it. Use this one carefully, if you hit a bunch of downers you'll insta-die.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011592/67152775183a29a1c7de7d25756844419e253592.png[/img]
[list][*][h1]Super Flow[/h1]
Flattens the entire arena for the duration of the wave and greatly increases the ball's sliding distance.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011592/bbf923dd5a901b6156ada72ae931c14421386426.png[/img]
[list][*][h1]Wrecking Ball[/h1]
Fortifies the ball with extra mass for 30 seconds. During this time, the ball does 13 damage anywhere it hits, and an additional 1 damage to all adjacent tiles. A Wrecking Ball can't be charged in the gutters or given Powershots.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011592/bd0b57ff5abb8a355a686892f94d2d5909500467.png[/img]
[list][*][h1]Jackpot[/h1]
Give you points! Note that the jackpot decreases with time, so the sooner you get it, the more you get.
[/list]
Thus concludes our guide.
We hope that this has shed some light on the mysterious workings of the Powerup, and that the next time you come across one, you see it in a slightly different light.

Good day, good game.

notes.title: We have a launch date :)
notes.content:
Hey everyone.

This has been an extreme year! 

Since releasing Early Access 2 last summer, the studio's been through a lot. We've been working very hard trying to build up the time and resource margin necessary to for us to complete Racket: Nx and release it a deserving fashion.

I'm very proud to say that we've succeeded in that.
[b]The full version of Racket: Nx will launch in mid July 2018![/b]

Here's what you can expect:

[h1]Lots of new content![/h1] New Solo and Multiplayer sets, and a richer Arcade wave pool. We're also making the difficulty curve smoother and more gradual.

[h1]Powerups![/h1] We've added a bunch of new powerups, some do some crazy ass shit. Powerups are also acquired in a new and cool way now. These really mix up the game and add strategy.

[h1]Visual Improvements![/h1] New Arena look for the Arcade Arena, new ball visuals, and two new space backgrounds.

[h1]Lots and lots of bug fixes![/h1] Including performance improvements, and final polishing.


Some of you may notice that we haven't included a level editor in this list. Though we really wanted to make it happen, we've had no choice but to decide not to include a level editor in the final release. Our sincere apologies to anyone who was hoping for it.


We'll be updating with more information in the coming weeks.


Thanks a lot to all of you!

notes.title: EA 2.0.5 Released!
notes.content:
Hey all,

We just updated the game a bit, here's the shortlist of changes:

[list]
    [*]Multiplayer matchmaking and friend invite bugs fixed
    [*]Game stuck syncing in start room bug fixed
    [*]Entanglement counter fixed
    [*]Voice comm loss bug fixed
    [*]Added 'stream cams' feature (activated through settings) this feature enable auto-directed action cameras to be displayed on your monitor. This is aimed at streamers who want a cooler view of the game but is also useful for your friends while they're watching you play
    [*]Undersampling was added because stream cams can affect performance
[/list]

Also, in a few hours we'll be updating our free demo, to reflect all of EA2 changes.

Do let us know if you run into any issues

Yours,
The RNX Team

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011592/817a18c77f66dc7135877145955f108f40bf1d49.jpg[/img]


[b]Hey there, boys and girls![/b]

The Free Weekend is about to come to a close, and I wanted to take the chance to tell you a bit about what's coming for RNX.

For over a month and half we've been working hard on our next big release, [b][i]Early Access 2: Open League.[/i][/b]
For those who don't already know us, we don't like releasing stuff before it's properly done and polished. Since EA2 touches on almost every aspect of the game, we can't really release it in bits and pieces without betraying our own standards. So it'll all come out when it's done :)

In the meantime, I'm glad to tell you about some of the major features you can expect from EA2:
[list]
[*] [b]Ranked Multiplayer[/b] - competitive multiplayer games will be ranked, players will be rated and fun will be had!

[*] [b]MUSIC![/b] - we've collected some of the finest electronic musicians to produce music in 6 channels for RNX. Expect glitch, trance, IDM, DnB, and more.

[*] [b]Upgraded Arena[/b] - our arena is going through some deep renovations as we speak. More on that down the road.

[*] [b]New Content[/b] - we're gonna have more stuff to do, additional tricks to learn and new tactics to develop.
[/list]
[h1]Thank you all for your patience, suggestions and feedback! I know we haven't made big updates in a few weeks, but it's going to pay back in dividends.[/h1]

- Dave

notes.title: Incoming Demo Update
notes.content:
Hey boys and girls!

A little heads up; we're going to be updating our Demo in the coming week.

The current version has been around since last summer (!) and we feel it's high time we update it with the most current graphics, sound and physics.

The demo will still offer the classic Arcade mode, but will no longer have a local leaderboard (it will have a global one instead), and each playthrough will have a hard time limit.

If for some reason you prefer staying with the current version of the demo, simply disable the auto-update for the demo via Steam.

Cya!

notes.title: EA 1.5 Update
notes.content:
It's time for another update with some exciting changes. We've worked really hard on finalizing our efforts for EA 1 and this will be the last update before we launch EA 2.0 (with the exception of bug fixes/patches if need be).

The most significant update here is in the actual physics of the racket/ball interactions. We did another deep pass and feel the accuracy and ability of players to execute their intended shots have increased dramatically.

We also did a complete optimization pass on all game modes so you can enjoy the smoothest, uninterrupted experience and forget you're not really in a glass dome, deep in space, taking on pulsing neon targets. 

This is also a good opportunity to thank everyone on our discord group who participated in the beta program - your feedback and support are invaluable and your attitude is nothing short of amazing.

Here's the change log:

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved physics, ball handling and plow direction detection
[*] Zen mode, an additional arcade mode which is very... zen
[/list]

[b]Tweaks & Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimizations (both CPU and GPU)
[*] Scoring tweaks in both Arcade and MP modes
[*] The gravity sling mechanics have changed to avoid abuse in multiplayer mode
[*] Gutters now pull the ball much quicker (all modes)
[*] Gutters in multiplayer only last a few seconds (to avoid stalling the game)
[*] Minor content changes and tweaks
[*] Snakes not registering hits bug fixed
[*] Several minor bug fixes
[*] Arcade levels are shuffled instead of randomized
[*] Fixed a bug in Mixed Reality with 2nd controller feature
[/list]

notes.title: EA1 coming to close. Prepare for EA2 - OPEN LEAGUE!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I'm here to update you guys and gals on our production plans for the near future.

Over the past couple of weeks we've seen the final of the multiplayer kinks straightened out and felt the excitement and engagement of real competition with [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RfYoqZwN07o]our first tournament.[/url]
Considering our next steps, we couldn't help but arrive at the conclusion that with all due respect to adding content (Sets, hex types, powerups...) as our roadmap suggested, we need ranked competitive multiplayer first. 
We gotta start building our league system. It is simply way more important for RNX's development right now, and with the state of our current build, we feel the game is definitely ready for it.

[b][i]So that's what we're gonna be doing next![/i][/b]


EA1 is going to get it's last update towards the end of the week.
This update, EA1.5, will include all the physics and performance improvements we've been developing and testing in the Beta over the past few weeks, as well as the long awaited Zen mode and some multiplayer balancing tweaks.

With this, we feel that we'll have accomplished what we've set out to do with Early Access 1 - to firmly lay down the game's foundations.

So towards the coming end of EA1, I want to give a bit shout out to all our players. The community that's gathered around RNX is nothing short of amazing, and we love you guys a whole shit ton. Thanks for your company and help during RNX's first two months. We're very proud to have you as our players!


As soon as EA1.5 is out, it's straight to:

[h1]Early Access 2 - Open League![/h1]

EA2 will unlock Season 1 of Racket: Nx's competitive league - for which we do not yet have a name* :) Season 1 is going to be Open League - that means that everyone will be playing from the same player pool, and will be relatively ranked according to their skill rating.
Skill rating will be determined by an adaptive win/loss point system. We'll expand on that down the road.
As our community grows, we'll open more leagues and start segregating them by player skill.

EA2 will take between one to two months of development, and during this time we won't be updating the public build.

We're stoked about this change of plan, because ranked play is going to be fun af! But also because we believe that this will be a unique, engaging and social thing to offer to the VR landscape. 
Besides, this is a step towards our vision of RNX becoming a VR eSport played competitively and watched by a scene of hardcore dudes and dudettes.


So that's our plan's update.
In the meantime, we're gonna continue with more and improved tournaments, so stay tuned here and on Discord.
You can see the full roadmap [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/428080/discussions/0/133255957994686293/]here.[/url]

Ciao!

- Dave



[i]* If anyone has a good suggestion, please write it in the comments.[/i]

notes.title: Racket: Nx Early Access 1.1 is LIVE
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011592/3c3b538eb82982bc2bb2eded481f3c98185f372e.jpg[/img]

So we got a new update in, with a bunch of features and fixes!
Let us know what you think here in the comment or on our Discord server https://discord.gg/mQsrRUr.

Here is the changelog:

[u][b] New Features: [/b] [/u]

[list]
[*]Invite Friend - players can now invite Steam friends playing RNX to matches. Go to Multiplayer > Invite Friend.
[*]Play while Finding Opponent - Arcade and Solo modes are now available while searching for an opponent. When an opponent if found, the player will be prompted.
[/list]

[u][b] Fixes: [/b] [/u]

[list]
[*]Fixed multiplayer issues with ball disappearing or behaving weird when latency is high.
[*]Fixed several minor bugs.
[/list]

[u][b]Tweaks & Additions:[/b] [/u]

[list]
[*]Added Swoosh visual and audio effect to the racket. Try it out!
[*]Portals got some love - we reduced the time portal take, added visual representation to active portals, and reduced overall portals in the game.
[*]Announcer can be muted through the Settings panel.
[*]Mic can be muted through the Settings panel.
[*]Added “Restart” button to Options menu in single player modes.
[*]Rotated starting room 180 degrees to match front of play area.
[*]Balls exiting Gutters now arrive closer up to the player.
[*]Added an additional Multiplayer set (chosen randomly).
[*]Added a legal notice to the start room.
[*]Improved Mixed Reality support.

[/list]

We'll be updating our Roadmap with our plans for the near future soon. 

GL HF!

notes.title: Racket: Nx to be released on Steam Early Access January 31 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011592/3682c3d4853581936c2aaa5f628dd41dc58524ee.jpg[/img]

2017 is going to be awesome and we are psyched to announce that Racket: Nx Early Access 1 will be released on Steam on January 31 for the HTC Vive.

Racket: Nx is an Arcade Space Sport. Imagine playing racquet-ball in a 360 arena, with classic arcade-style game rules and influences. Now put that arena in outer space and you've got RNX.

Racket: Nx Early Access 1 is the first of three major Early Access updates we plan to release on Steam in 2017. Racket: Nx Early Access 1 features are:

* Single-Player mode
* Competitive Multiplayer mode
* Arcade mode (previously known as Training)
* A bunch of gameplay, visual and auditory improvements since the Demo  
  we released in 2016.

Each Early Access update will continue to expand the game with new features such as ranked play, replay options, spectator mode, level editing and sharing, etc. and we’ll  also be routinely updating with gameplay tweaks and bug fixes. Our entire roadmap is public and we'll be keeping it alive and responsive as player feedback and design considerations develop. The full game will be released at the end of 2017.

Racket: Nx Early Access 1 will be priced at $19.99. Each Early Access update will see the price rise slightly, as we add more content and features to the game. 

Our vision for Racket: Nx is to create the first eSports game for VR. That means making the physics tight and precise, encouraging players to always push the bar and improve their game. It means giving our all to the audio-visuals, making the game fun to play and to watch. It means introducing game elements that adds drama and make competitive games nail-biting. And above all, it means nurturing our community and treating our players with respect, trust and honesty.

On this note, we want to thank everyone who played the Racket: Nx demo. Thank you for your feedback, for posting videos, and for the overwhelmingly positive responses. You have made us and our partners, Waves Audio and Keshet International Gaming, believe in this vision and go all-in for it.

If you want more info and to stay updated on our progress, join us here:

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/racketnx/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/racketnx
Website: https://racketnx.com/

Much love and Happy 2017!

/ Boof, Usul, Matan, Niv, Egozy, Ziv, Bozar, Yehogaak and Dave.

notes.title: Early Access Steam Announcement
notes.content:
Hey guys!

Thanks for being so patient, we've been wanting to make this announcement for a long while now and are happy to say that we can finally do so with full confidence.

Racket: Nx will be launching in Steam Early Access in late January 2017!

We know we promised late 2016, but this delay is due to us getting a new partner on board the project, securing our ambitions for the game's development over 2017.

The first Early Access release is going to include these major features:

* Competitive Multiplayer
* Single player mode (in addition to the current Training mode)
* Additional gameplay features
* A bunch of other stuff :)

We'll be releasing more information about these over the next couple of months, and an official public announcement will be made towards the launch date.

During 2017 we will continue to update the Early Access with content and features towards the full game release later that year. The main features we will be adding throughout 2017 are:

* More multiplayer modes
* A League system
* Level editor and other user generated content creation and sharing tools
* eSport features (observer mode, custom match settings, etc.)
* Sick music ;)

The main reason we're going for Steam Early Access is that we want to get something out there as soon as possible. First of all to see that people want it, but also to start getting feedback to help us understand which features to focus on, which features to dump, and just in general to tailor the game to the Vive community.

Since the Demo's release, we've been getting so much helpful feedback, ideas, and love from you guys here on Steam and on Reddit. It's really what made development on this game possible for us, motivating us immensely and inspiring confidence in our partners.
We'd like to thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your participation and efforts and we can't wait to start the Early Access process with you guys.

Let's go make the sickest game VR has seen!

Much love,
Niv, Usul, Boof, Matan, Dave, Bozar and Egozy.

notes.title: Demo build update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've just updated the demo build. The new demo has a few differences:

[list]
[*] Improvements to ball/racket physics calculations
[*] Changes to the way the trigger (call ball) behaves
[*] Minor content changes
[/list]

Sorry, but we had to reset your local leaderboard entries as these changes have an impact on the game's difficulty/score mechanisms.

We're still working towards getting everyone a global leaderboard so you can tell how well you are doing vs. the rest of community.

Thanks for all the feedback so far and keep playing!
the Racket: Nx team.
